title: NerVast private chunk weights replaced by Mirror code
hypothesis: On top of the same fitted NerVast shared-weight masks, structured Mirror coordinates can replace some remaining chunk-private weights while preserving held-out scene-window RD quality and decode rate better than equal-byte low-rank/FiLM controls.

logical_multiplicity: More temporal chunks represented by one shared decoder and fewer private chunk weights.
